services.title: What I can do for your business
services.lead: Seven ways to bring AI into your work. Not sure which one you need? We start with the assessment.

items.title: AI assessment and strategy
items.text: We look at how you work today and find where AI really saves time, without buying tools you won't use.

items.title: AI agents and integrations
items.text: I connect AI to the software you already use: AutoCAD, Excel, your CRM or your inbox. For example, drafting floor plans from a description or preparing reports on their own.

items.title: AI marketing and content
items.text: Agents that research your niche, write copy, generate images and videos and build your posting calendar. You review and approve.

items.title: Website with an AI chatbot
items.text: A fast, clear website connected to WhatsApp, with an assistant that answers common questions and books appointments while you work.

items.title: Process automation
items.text: Forms that land in your spreadsheet on their own, automatic reminders, invoices and customer follow-up with n8n or Make.

items.title: AI workshops for teams
items.text: Hands-on sessions for any field: how to use ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini on your team's real tasks.

items.title: Cloud and DevOps
items.text: Hosting, automatic deployments, monitoring and AWS: a technical foundation that holds when your product grows.

about.title: About me
about.name: Dixon G. Araya Arias
about.role: IT & AI consultant and DevOps and Cloud engineer
bio: I'm a computer engineer who graduated with honors from UNED in Costa Rica. I have more than five years in tech: three running enterprise-grade cloud platforms and two as a backend developer.
I started Buildream to bring that experience to small businesses: explain AI in plain words and make it work where it actually helps.

items.q: Do I need to know about technology?
items.a: No. I explain every step in plain words and leave you a short guide so you or your team can use it without depending on me.
Every project gets a tailored quote. We start with a free 30-minute call, then I send you a proposal with scope, timeline and price.

items.q: Do you work outside Costa Rica?
items.a: Yes. I work remotely with businesses across Latin America and beyond, in Spanish or English.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: It depends on scope. A website with a chatbot or a simple automation is usually ready in one to three weeks.
I stay with you for the first weeks to adjust what's needed. If you want, we can agree on monthly support.
I use well-known tools, least-privilege access and explain where each piece of data lives. Nothing goes live without your approval.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
body: Buildream only collects the data you send through the contact form: name, email, company and message.
I use that data only to reply and prepare your proposal. I don't sell it or share it with third parties, except the provider that processes the form (Netlify).
You can ask me to delete your data at any time by writing to dixon.ar08@gmail.com.
This site doesn't use tracking or advertising cookies.

terms.title: Terms of use
body: The content of this site is informational and is not a formal offer. Every service is agreed in writing in a proposal.
Third-party technology names and logos belong to their owners and are shown only to indicate the tools I work with.
Projects marked as concept projects are demonstrations and do not represent real clients.
